description: NaNb₃(TeO₄)₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.52-2.93 Å. There are two inequivalent Nb sites. In the first Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 15-36°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.88-2.20 Å. In the second Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 15-32°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.97-2.03 Å. There are four inequivalent Te sites. In the first Te site, Te is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.84 Å) and two longer (1.94 Å) Te-O bond lengths. In the second Te site, Te is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Te-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.21 Å. In the third Te site, Te is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Te-O bond distances ranging from 1.91-2.48 Å. In the fourth Te site, Te is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.87 Å) and two longer (1.95 Å) Te-O bond lengths. There are eleven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Nb and one Te atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Nb atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Nb atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Nb, and one Te atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Nb and one Te atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and two Te atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂Te₂ tetrahedra. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Nb atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two Te atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and two Te atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂Te₂ tetrahedra. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to two Nb atoms. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one Nb, and one Te atom.
